instagram.caption:
Plumbing and HVAC business owners: three ways to catch missed calls, and what each costs.

The three fixes, priced (each maker's own pricing page, read Nov 1, 2026; one example of each kind, not a pick):
1. Missed-call text: Quo Starter, $19 a month per user billed monthly ($15 a month paid yearly; carrier fees extra). It texts the caller back automatically. You still call back.
2. A live person: PATLive Pay as you go, $49 a month plus $2.99 a minute (no minutes included; taxes and fees extra). A person takes the call. Long calls cost you.
3. AI receptionist: Rosie Professional, $49 a month for 250 minutes. It answers and texts a booking link (calendar booking is on its higher plans). Before you pay, call it yourself as an angry customer.

This week:
1. Turn on a missed-call text with these words (our example, make it yours):
Sorry I missed you, I'm on a job. I'll call you back inside the hour. What do you need?
2. Call every missed call back inside the hour. The text answers right away so they know you'll call back; your callback is what books the job.
Can't call back inside the hour? That's when a person or an AI earns its price.

The rule: call missed calls back inside the hour, and the $19 text is worth it.
Part 2 of 2: part 1 was counting what your missed calls are worth (our example shop: $2,800 a month).

Send this to whoever answers your phone when you can't.
